releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.1.0 - Decoded Audio Waveforms, Shareable Lyric Cards, Multi-Select Library, Multi-Style Widgets & Hi-Res Telemetry
releaseNotes: Introduces real-time decoded audio PCM waveform scrub bars with peak amplitude extraction, 1080px shareable lyric card generator with 4 curated card themes, comprehensive multi-select library management with batch actions, 3 all-new multi-style home screen widgets (Minimal Floating Pill 2x1, Spinning Vinyl Turntable 2x2, and Master Deck Dashboard 4x2), persistent Hi-Res audio stream telemetry badge, and precision A-B repeat practice looper.
